answer: Admission auctions make each identity a pearl: scarce and costly to win. Each epoch auctions 50 slots; top bidders enter, locking 30 POA for 20 epochs. Honest work refunds the deposit in full; fraud slashes it. A gale of fake sign-ups lifts the clearing price, so 100 identities cost 100 bids while one honest agent pays once. Onyx seals mark admitted identities; a public referral graph flags clusters sharing one funding source.
